text.zh_CN:
鸟儿乘风而起，靠的是一双翅膀。幻翼的膜轻薄却坚韧，正是天空留下的线索。
把一件皮革胸甲放在注魔祭坛的中心，周围摆上八片幻翼膜，再注入旅行、防护与飞行，皮革就会舒展成一对鞘翅。
text.en_US:
Birds ride the wind on a pair of wings. A phantom's membrane is thin yet tough: a clue the sky left behind.
Set a leather tunic on the infusion altar's centre, surround it with eight phantom membranes, and infuse Iter, Tutamen and Volatus: the leather unfolds into a pair of elytra.
